name: Grammar Basics
description: 10 quick questions on essential grammar rules.
description_es: 10 preguntas rápidas sobre reglas gramaticales esenciales.

questions.question: Which is correct: 'The team are playing' or 'The team is playing'?
questions.question_es: ¿Cuál es correcto: 'The team are playing' o 'The team is playing'?
questions.explanation: In American English, 'team' is singular, so 'is' is correct.

questions.question: Choose the sentence without errors: A) Everyone have finished. B) Everyone has finished.
questions.question_es: Elige la oración sin errores: A) Everyone have finished. B) Everyone has finished.

questions.question: What is a run-on sentence?

options.text: A sentence that is too long
options.text_es: Una oración que es muy larga

options.text: Two independent clauses joined without proper punctuation or conjunction
options.text_es: Dos cláusulas independientes unidas sin puntuación o conjunción adecuadas

options.text: A sentence with too many verbs

questions.explanation: A run-on joins two complete thoughts without proper connection.

questions.question: Which punctuation ends an interrogative sentence?
questions.explanation: A question ends with a question mark.

questions.question: What is the difference between 'its' and 'it's'?

options.text: 'its' = possessive; 'it's' = it is or it has
options.text_es: 'its' = posesivo; 'it's' = it is o it has

questions.explanation: 'Its' shows possession (the dog and its bone). 'It's' = it is/has.

questions.question: Correct: 'She dont like coffee' or 'She doesn't like coffee'?
questions.question_es: ¿Correcto: 'She dont like coffee' o 'She doesn't like coffee'?
questions.explanation: 'doesn't' is the correct contraction of 'does not'.

questions.question: What is a clause?

options.text: A group of words with a subject and verb
options.text_es: Un grupo de palabras con un sujeto y verbo

questions.explanation: A clause contains a subject and predicate (verb).

questions.question: When should you use a semicolon?
questions.question_es: ¿Cuándo debes usar un punto y coma?

options.text_es: Entre un adjetivo y un sustantivo

options.text: To join two independent clauses or separate items in a complex list
options.text_es: Para unir dos cláusulas independientes o separar elementos en una lista compleja

options.text: At the end of every sentence

questions.explanation: Semicolons join related independent clauses or separate complex list items.

questions.question: Which is a sentence fragment? A) Running quickly down the street. B) She ran down the street.
questions.question_es: ¿Cuál es un fragmento? A) Running quickly down the street. B) She ran down the street.
questions.explanation: The first lacks a main subject + verb; it's a phrase, not a complete sentence.

questions.question: What is parallel structure in writing?
questions.question_es: ¿Qué es la estructura paralela en la escritura?

options.text_es: Usar la misma palabra dos veces

options.text: Using similar grammatical forms for items in a list or series
options.text_es: Usar formas gramaticales similares para elementos en una lista o serie

options.text: Writing on two lines at once
options.text_es: Escribir en dos líneas a la vez

questions.explanation: Parallel structure balances grammatical forms (e.g., 'I came, I saw, I conquered').

name: APA Citations 101
description: Quick review of essential APA citation rules.
description_es: Repaso rápido de reglas esenciales de citación APA.

questions.question: In APA style, how do you cite a book by one author?
questions.question_es: En estilo APA, ¿cómo citas un libro de un autor?

options.text: Author, A. (Year). Title of book. Publisher.
options.text_es: Autor, A. (Año). Título del libro. Editorial.

questions.explanation: APA format: Last name, Initial(s). (Year). Title. Publisher.

questions.question: What goes inside parentheses in a direct quote citation?
questions.question_es: ¿Qué va entre paréntesis en una cita directa?

options.text: Author and year (and page if direct quote)
options.text_es: Autor y año (y página si cita directa)

questions.explanation: In-text citations include author, year, and page number for direct quotes: (Author, Year, p. #).

questions.question: How do you cite a source with two authors in APA?
questions.question_es: ¿Cómo citas una fuente con dos autores en APA?
questions.explanation: APA uses '&' in parenthetical citations and 'and' in narrative citations.

questions.question: What is the difference between a Reference list and a Bibliography?
questions.question_es: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre una lista de referencias y una bibliografía?

options.text: APA uses 'References' (sources cited); Bibliography includes all sources consulted
options.text_es: APA usa 'Referencias' (fuentes citadas); Bibliografía incluye todas las fuentes consultadas

options.text: Bibliography is older; References is new
options.text_es: Bibliografía es más antigua; Referencias es nueva

questions.explanation: In APA, only cited sources go in 'References'. A bibliography may include uncited sources.

questions.question: How is a Reference list arranged?
questions.question_es: ¿Cómo se organiza una lista de referencias?
questions.explanation: References are alphabetized by author's last name.

questions.question: What is a DOI in an APA citation?
questions.question_es: ¿Qué es un DOI en una cita APA?

options.text: Digital Object Identifier — a permanent URL for online sources
options.text_es: Identificador de Objeto Digital — una URL permanente para fuentes en línea

questions.explanation: DOI is a stable link. Use it instead of a URL if available.

questions.question: True or False: In APA, titles of articles are capitalized like book titles.
questions.question_es: Verdadero o Falso: En APA, los títulos de artículos se capitalizan como títulos de libros.
questions.explanation: In APA, article titles use sentence case (capitalize only first word and proper nouns).

questions.question: What is the hanging indent in APA?
questions.question_es: ¿Qué es la sangría colgante en APA?

options.text: The second and subsequent lines are indented (References format)
options.text_es: La segunda y siguientes líneas se indentan (formato de Referencias)

questions.explanation: Reference entries use hanging indent: first line flush left, rest indented 0.5 inches.
